parameters.query: SELECT vacancy_id, code, title, vacante_estado, total_postulaciones, pendientes, en_entrevista, finalizados, con_error, score_promedio, score_maximo FROM talentflow.vw_bot_metricas WHERE ($1::text IS NULL OR vacancy_id::text = $1 OR code ILIKE $1 OR title ILIKE '%'||$1||'%') ORDER BY total_postulaciones DESC LIMIT 20
